basic_details.job_title: NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow (Architecture and Planning) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Architecture and Planning of the National Institute of Technology Calicut needs one Junior Research Fellow (JRF). The JRF will work on contract for 10 months on a Digital Twin project for Cherthala Municipality. The project is sponsored by CoEUPD-NIT Calicut under the INSIGHT4CITIES Program. The consolidated pay is ₹37,000/- + 20% HRA a month. Candidates need a first-class Master's degree in a listed field with 60% marks or a CGPA of 6.0/10. A valid GATE or NET qualification is also required. Applications are sent by e-mail to [email protected] and must be submitted by 10 Dec

Department of Architecture and Planning, NIT Calicut

content_sections.heading: About NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Technology Calicut is a technical institute in Calicut. The Office of Research and Consultancy of the institute issued this notice. The JRF post is part of a research project in the Department of Architecture and Planning. The project is building a Digital Twin Model to assess the climate resilience of drainage, natural drain pathways, canals, private plots and flood-prone areas in Cherthala Municipality.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: First-class Master's degree in Engineering / Urban Planning / Geospatial Technologies / Remote Sensing / Geoinformatics, with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks (or) CGPA of 6.0/10. Valid GATE or NET qualification is mandatory. Applications from candidates without a valid GATE or NET qualification will not be considered. Development skills in handling GPS, GIS and similar technologies. Prior exposure to field studies in GIS and Planning. Experience in Predictive and Generative AI. Proficiency in technical writing in English. Experience in web interface development. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience for candidates with exceptional credentials. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The JRF gets a consolidated monthly pay of ₹37,000/-. A 20% HRA is paid on top of this amount. The engagement is on contract basis for a duration of 10 months. The notice does not mention any extension of the engagement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Fill in the registration form annexed to the notice. Attach your most recent CV. Attach soft copies of the mark sheets/certificates that support your academic qualification/experience. Attach a copy of your GATE/NET score card/certificate. This is a must. Combine all the soft copies into a single PDF document. E-mail the PDF to [email protected] and send a copy to [email protected] . Use the subject line "Application for JRF – Cherthala Project" . The application must be submitted by 10 December 2026. The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, documents and photograph submitted. Duly filled registration form (as annexed) Most recent CV Soft copies of mark sheets/certificates for academic qualification/experience Copy of the GATE/NET score card/certificate No Objection Certificate from the employer, for applicants already in employment. This is submitted at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: NIT Calicut will first shortlist the applications. Eligible candidates will be notified by email and invited for the interview. The interview will be held in hybrid mode (Online/Offline) on 15 December 2026. Some applicants are already employed by the government or by any other organisation. These applicants must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of interview, along with the documents listed above. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Calicut JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the Department of Architecture and Planning, NIT Calicut.

faq.answer: The last date for application submission is 10 December 2026. The interview is on 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a first-class Master's degree in Engineering / Urban Planning / Geospatial Technologies / Remote Sensing / Geoinformatics with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks (or) CGPA of 6.0/10. A valid GATE or NET qualification is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NIT Calicut JRF?

faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the pay as ₹37,000/- plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: Combine the registration form, CV, mark sheets/certificates and GATE/NET score card into one PDF file. E-mail it to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected], using the subject line "Application for JRF – Cherthala Project".

faq.question: Q7. How will the NIT Calicut JRF be selected?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted first. Eligible candidates are notified by email and invited to a hybrid (Online/Offline) interview on 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIT Calicut JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on contract basis for a duration of 10 months under the Cherthala Municipality Digital Twin project.
